title: build(deps): bump axios from 1.20.0 to 1.21.0 in /packages/client
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. Production dependency (dependencies, not devDependencies), minor version inside the existing ^1 range. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest and CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 makes a borrowed one invalid; that friction is the point.
behavior_change: None in the shipped client: axios contributes ZERO bytes to the production bundle under either version. `vite build` with axios 1.20.0 and with 1.21.0 on the same tree produced 203 files each, byte-identical (diff -rq empty); neither bundle contains the axios VERSION string or the XSRF-TOKEN default. Value-only import walk from src/main.ts (import type edges excluded): of the 20 src files importing axios, 19 are unreachable and the 20th, src/api/job_int.ts, is reachable only through the barrel components/cam/composables/index.ts, whose axios-calling exports CamPipelineRunner.vue does not use, so Rollup tree-shakes them. The shipped /api/cam/job-int/log calls are the fetch-based api() wrapper (CompareRunsPanel.vue, useJobIntHistoryClone.ts, useJobTooltip.ts). Effect is therefore limited to vitest and vue-tsc, both A/B-identical. Lockfile enumerated against the original merge base eafbad16 (400->400, 0 added, 0 removed): exactly one version moves, node_modules/axios 1.20.0->1.21.0; its own dependency ranges are unchanged. Dependabot's regeneration flipped the `peer` flag on 16 unchanged-version entries (npm-version churn); reverted per main's convention since ec88eedd. Branch merged with origin/main 0b946f97 (after #467 and #468) and the lockfile rebuilt as main's lockfile + the axios root range and package entry, so the diff against main is axios only.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json declares axios ^1.21.0 (was ^1.20.0). packages/client/package-lock.json resolves axios 1.21.0 (root dependencies range + the one package entry: version, resolved, integrity). No other lockfile line differs from origin/main 0b946f97.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency. The bump is open as PR #470 and both CBSP21 gates fail there for want of a manifest of its own; this is that manifest.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No source file. No build, lint or test configuration. No other dependency. Lockfile `peer` flags stay as on main. The 20 axios-importing src files, 19 of them orphaned, are recorded here and NOT pruned: removing axios or dead code does not belong in a dependency PR.

commands_run: git merge-base origin/main b0e4c283 -> eafbad16; origin/main had moved to 0b946f97 (#467, #468 merged); git merge origin/main (no force-push)
lockfile JSON enumeration eafbad16 vs b0e4c283 -> 400->400, 0 added, 0 removed, 1 version change (axios 1.20.0->1.21.0), 16 peer-flag-only entries
lockfile rebuilt = origin/main lockfile + axios root range + package entry; serializer round-trips main byte-for-byte; git diff origin/main -- packages/client shows only the 3 axios changes

npm view axios@1.21.0: dist.integrity == lockfile; _npmUser 'GitHub Actions' trustedPublisher github (OIDC), approver jasonsaayman, SLSA provenance v1 (same publishing path as 1.20.0); dependencies identical to 1.20.0; no install/postinstall hook (prepare does not run for registry installs)

npm pack axios@1.20.0 axios@1.21.0, diff -ru lib/: 30 files changed + 3 new (assertParamsAcyclic.js, createMultipartBody.js, formDataToBlob.js). Added-line scan for eval/new Function/child_process/require/dynamic import/URLs/fetch/XHR/storage/cookie: hits are only the refactored XSRF cookie reader, existing data-URI decode, basic-auth btoa, and IPv6 normalization in the node-only proxy bypass
npm run type-check -> check_client_type_check_ratchet.py PASS (87, ceiling 87)

vitest run --reporter=json under 1.21.0 and under npm i --no-save axios@1.20.0 -> 814 tests, 0 per-test status differences; the only failed suite (testing/__tests__/nodeEngineFloor.spec.ts, parse error) fails identically under both and is a known Windows-local failure, green on CI
vite build under 1.20.0 and 1.21.0 -> 203 files each, diff -rq empty; grep XSRF-TOKEN / axios VERSION in dist -> 0 in both
value-only import walk from src/main.ts with controls: src/auth/supabase.ts LIVE (positive), RMOSCncJobDetailView.vue orphan (known negative)
manual_verifications: Lockfile was enumerated by parsing both JSON trees, NOT by reading the diff view (PR #296 precedent).

1.21.0 behavior changes read in source, not from release notes: (a) xhr adapter reads the XSRF cookie asynchronously via window.cookieStore when present and defers setRequestHeader/send until after it -- inert here, no XSRF/CSRF/withCredentials anywhere in client src or services/api/app; (b) headers.common/headers[method] are only treated as default buckets when plain objects or AxiosHeaders -- inert, no axios.create/defaults/interceptors/AxiosHeaders in client src; (c) params are deep-copied and circular params now throw ERR_BAD_OPTION_VALUE -- client params are flat records; (d) get/post/put/delete aliases became async, so a synchronous config throw becomes a rejection -- all call sites await inside async functions.

First version of the reachability walker reported src/auth/supabase.ts as an orphan (Windows mixed-slash paths from @/ aliases); the positive control caught it, paths were normalized, and type-only import edges were excluded before trusting the orphan verdict.

files.intent: Declared production dependency version bump inside the existing ^1 range.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Dependency bump; no architectural surface. The lockfile moves nothing beyond axios itself. Finding recorded, not fixed here: axios is a declared production dependency that ships zero bytes (19 of 20 importers orphaned, the 20th tree-shaken behind a barrel); candidate for a separate dead-code / dependency-removal PR.
